source: Fingrid Open Data API (CC BY 4.0): the hourly balance of sql/analysis/24; SYKE Hydrology API (Finnish Environment Institute, CC BY 4.0): water levels of Lokka, Porttipahta, Oulujärvi, Saimaa and Näsijärvi and discharge of the unregulated Tornionjoki; NVE reservoir statistics (NLOD)
model: hourly OLS of hydro, imports, other production and consumption on wind, wind x storage and wind x inflow (the day before, each against its 2000-2022 norm for the date), storage, inflow, nuclear and heating degrees, with hour, weekday, month and year fixed effects; Newey-West 95 % intervals. Associations, not proven causes.
storage: mean z-score of five reservoir and lake levels against the same calendar day in 2000-2022 (0 = normal for the date; one unit = one standard deviation of a single reservoir's level)
